questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "upcycle" mean?
options: A decrease in the quality of a product over time
A method of reducing production costs
A process of recycling old materials into new ones
A rise in demand that leads to higher prices for a product

questions.question: What does the word "pre‑tax" mean in the sentence "Banks alone posted pre‑tax profit of NT$400.2bn"?
options: Profit earned before any taxes are deducted
Profit that comes from tax refunds
Profit after all taxes have been paid
Profit that is taxed at a lower rate
questions.explain_en: The term "pre‑tax" refers to profit calculated before any tax expenses are subtracted.
questions.explain_zh: 「pre‑tax」指的是在扣除稅金之前的盈餘。
